regions.region: page 1 title, author block, abstract, keywords, and SI availability sentence
regions.finding: Verified the actual article title and aggregate Pd-catalyzed allenyne/organic iodide/NaN3 tandem claim. Although online SI is mentioned, workspace association is unestablished and no SI fact was imported.
Biologically active bicyclic triazole examples provide motivation only; they are not experiments of the current article and no reaction records were created.
The generic Z/E-Int-1 and Int-2 selectivity challenge is classified as a general scheme. Its hypothetical/cited Cu cycloaddition branches are not assigned current-paper experimental yields.

unresolved: Generic Ar/X groups and hypothetical intermediates do not define unique structures or experiment-specific quantities.

regions.region: page 2 Results and Discussion initial model reaction
regions.finding: The CuI-containing 1a/2a/NaN3 reaction is Table 1 entry 1 and was not duplicated; precursor yields, 48% 5aa NMR yield, and non-detection of 6aa remain product-specific outcomes.

regions.region: page 2 Table 1 reaction header, entries 1–10, and footnotes
regions.finding: Ten distinct solvent experiments retain row time, three precursor yields or source dashes, 5aa NMR yield/dash, 1a recovery/dash, NMR basis, N2 atmosphere, solvent volume, and the entry-1 CuI footnote.

regions.region: page 2 Table 2 reaction header, entries 1–8, and footnotes
regions.finding: Eight distinct temperature/loading experiments retain 2a/NaN3 equivalents, temperature, time, precursor triplets/dashes, 5aa NMR yields, common catalyst/ligand/solvent conditions, and measurement basis.
Narrative statements map to Table 3 and Table 4 on page 3 and were linked to those rows rather than duplicated.

unresolved: Optimization rows omit workup, purification, isolated masses, and detection limits.
Table dashes are preserved as source markers rather than treated as zero unless prose explicitly says no product.

regions.region: page 3 Table 3 reaction header, entries 1–9, and footnotes
regions.finding: Nine independent ligand experiments retain ligand identity/omission, 10 or footnoted 5 mol% loading, time, precursor NMR yields, 5aa NMR yield, and shared conditions. Entry 9 is explicitly ligand-free.

regions.region: page 3 Table 4 reaction header, entries 1–15, and footnotes
regions.finding: Fifteen independent organic-iodide scope runs retain row iodide identity, time, isolated yield, common conditions, 120 °C overrides, and entry-15 0.2 mmol/3 equiv/sealed-tube override.

regions.region: page 3 Table 5 reaction header, nine displayed products/trial outcomes, and footnotes
regions.finding: Nine allenyne-scope trials were retained separately, including the 0.2 mmol 5hh row and the complicated 1o trial where 5oa was not formed.
The narrative introduces substituted-allenyne reactions shown on page 4; they are represented as separate arrows there, with paired stereoisomers kept in one experiment per arrow.

unresolved: Table 4/5 omit workups, product masses, and purifications on pages 1–6.
Complex products and several scope substrates remain label-only and structure-unverified.

regions.finding: Five distinct reactions were retained: 1j/2f, 1k/2b, 1k/2f, 1l/2f, and 1m/2f. Paired isolated yields target the corresponding stereoisomers/diastereoisomers within one record per arrow.
ORTEP drawings characterize cis-5jf, E-5kf, cis-5lf, and 5mf; they are not additional preparations and do not verify machine structure encodings.
One room-temperature 1a/2a/NaN3 experiment retains crude NMR yields 17/44/34 and distinct isolated contaminated-fraction yields 17/37/25 with printed compositions 90/4/6, 2/98/0, and 2/5/93.
Seven additional controls were retained independently: three 43 h room-temperature interconversions, three 100 °C/8.5 h thermal cycloadditions, and one 100 °C/3 h Pd/TFP-accelerated cycloaddition.

regions.region: page 4 lower-right Scheme 4 and mechanism prose
regions.finding: The Int-3/Int-4 oxidative-addition/insertion/nucleophilic-attack model is classified as mechanism; proposed intermediates are not experimental preparations.

unresolved: Control schemes omit many absolute amounts, solvent volumes, workups, and internal-standard details.
Crystallography supports source assignments but does not certify candidate SMILES.

regions.region: page 5 upper-left mechanism continuation and Equation 1
regions.finding: Mechanism prose continues Scheme 4. A separate one-pot two-stage 1n/2a/NaN3 experiment was retained with 25 °C/23 h followed by 130 °C/21 h and a 38% sequence-level yield for 5na.
Conclusion adds no independent experiment. General analytical/material statements were inspected as context; the SI mention was not converted into an association.

regions.region: page 5 right column Typical Procedure I and preparation of 1b
regions.finding: The 1b Mitsunobu preparation retains exact PPh3/A1/B1/DEAD/THF charges, N2, 0 °C DEAD addition for 2 min, gradual warming with missing ramp time, room-temperature 23 h hold, chromatography, 1.3713 g, 76% isolated yield, and 98% purity.

A distinct 1c preparation under Typical Procedure I retains exact 1 mmol-scale charges, 0 °C/1 min DEAD addition, gradual warming, 23 h room-temperature hold, chromatography, 0.2646 g/72%, and 71.6–72.3 °C melting point.

unresolved: The one-pot 5na arrow omits yield basis, workup, purification, and isolated mass on page 5.
Gradual warming durations in Typical Procedure I are not reported.

regions.finding: Distinct 5 mmol 1d preparation retains exact charges, 0 °C/2 min addition, gradual warming, 23 h room-temperature hold, chromatography, 1.3329 g, and 75% isolated yield.
Distinct 5 mmol 1e preparation retains exact charges, 0 °C/3 min addition, gradual warming, 24.3 h room-temperature hold, chromatography, 1.4875 g/80%, and 75.8–76.4 °C melting point.
Distinct 3.3 mmol 1f preparation retains exact charges, 0 °C/2 min addition, gradual warming, 24 h room-temperature hold, chromatography, 0.4645 g/41%, and 71.0–71.7 °C melting point.
Distinct 5 mmol 1g preparation retains exact charges, 0 °C/3 min addition, gradual warming, 29.5 h room-temperature hold, chromatography, 1.1904 g/74%, and 98% purity.

unresolved: All four gradual warming-transition durations are unreported.
No aqueous workup is described before evaporation/chromatography.
